721663001.text: ...Maybe I just wish that all will go well with him...

721663002.text: It's been so long since I've seen him...

721663003.text: Who knows... Now that I think about it, I pity him.

721663004.text: Sayo left him behind and left the Sea of Fog. I'm afraid...

721663005.text: Doesn't seem like we can be of any help here...

721663101.text: I wonder how Big Brother Kama's doing...

721663201.text: Whatever the case, old man, just mind your own mushrooms.

721663202.text: Hey now, the Fluorescent Fungi are the good stuff, alright?

721663203.text: I'll bring some for you once the ceremony's over.

721663204.text: Uh, well, much obliged. If not, never mind my eyes, I think my mind might be going too.

721663205.text: Why, I can barely tell Kito and Kina apart at this point.

721663206.text: ...Whatever the case, don't concern yourself too much with what happened to the Kama family...

721661401.text: The fog here... really is super thick...

721661402.text: Speaking of which, Paimon wonders what's happening back with Miss Sumida? It seems like she mentioned that she intended to gather all those who took up her commission to meet and discuss some stuff with us...

721660101.text: Really now, asking me to walk all this way. If this wasn't about "a once-in-a-century find..."

721660102.text: Eh? We've only walked a few steps away from Bantan Sango's storefront, haven't we?

721660105.text: Bantan Sango is my house of wisdom. The world comes to Bantan Sango, not the other way around.

721660106.text: There it is. No. 7 of the lines that President Sango wishes she could say someday.

721660107.text: But since cases tend to come to her, she's never had a chance to say it...

721660108.text: H—Hey, you don't have to say so much, Ryuuji!

721660110.text: #Ah, you're here. Let me introduce you. This is the renowned {NICKNAME}...

721660111.text: You can, uh, skip the "renowned" bit.

721660115.text: Well, your deeds have far surpassed the domain of your average adventurer, that's for sure — indeed, your adventures are what all adventurers' dreams are made of!

721660117.text: Right. Let's get to the point. The reason I've asked everyone to gather here is to exchange information about Tsurumi Island.

721663501.text: The Maushiro... It's the key to writing "The Chronicles of the Sea of Fog (Working Title)"...

721660203.text: You went missing earlier. I thought that you'd ended up like all the others...

721660205.text: That's right. I met other outlanders before as well. But they all went missing, and then they never came back.

721660206.text: There was a man in green, and another guy who called himself a "detective"... I wonder what's happened to all of them...

721660207.text: Huh, those people sure sound like Roald and Ryuuji, don't they?

721660209.text: We met them both just a while back!

721660210.text: That's good... I was afraid that they'd gotten lost in the fog or gotten eaten by those monsters that look like dogs...

721660211.text: Nah, that won't happen! They've got the skills, y'know? Well, sorta.

721660212.text: Still, we did encounter a whole lotta weird stuff after splitting up with you, Ruu...

721660213.text: We don't know where the Maushiro we found's gone either.

721660214.text: The Maushiro? You should still have it on you, I think. I can feel its power on you.

721660216.text: I once heard Grandpa Mata say...

721660217.text: ...So the Thunderbird's feathers were the original "Maushiro"?

721660218.text: That's right. I can feel that same sort of... power from you, I guess?

721660219.text: Huh, speaking of feathers, Paimon's reminded of something...

721660222.text: Ohh, that's right! That did happen.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to your destination and use the feather

721660401.text: I hope that... No, the Great Thunderbird will surely be pleased with the ceremony this time...

721660402.text: After all, this is the only child that she has shown favor to in all these years...

721660403.text: Eminent Priest, Ruu has yet to arrive.

721660404.text: ...This is the final day. Let him wander for a little while longer.

721660405.text: But the Great Thunderbird has already returned to Mt. Kanna!

721660406.text: Is that so? Then truly, our time is limited...

721660407.text: Is there anything we can help with? Ruu's our friend.

721660409.text: Please look for him in these places. I believe that you might find him there.

721660410.text: Leave it to us! We'll find Ruu for sure!

721660411.text: Wakukau Shoal, Oina Beach, and Autake Plains...

721660412.text: Forgive my forwardness, but I do not think these are places where a child should go...

721660413.text: That is true. But these are his favorite spots.

721660414.text: It was at Autake Plains that Ruu encountered the Great Thunderbird, wasn't it?

721660415.text: Yes. When we were together, he would often talk about the times he went fishing with Ipe by the shore at Wakukau, and how he would pick seashells at Oina with Sayo and the Kama family's boy.

721660416.text: Sayo... That loudmouth. She always talks about the world outside the Sea of Fog. We should've left her outside the fog with nothing but three days' rations, just like our forebears used to do.

721660418.text: If we had, Kama wouldn't have ended up like that, either...

721660417.text: This is all past tense now. There's nothing more to be said.

721660419.text: I must continue making preparations for the Thunderbird's descent. I leave the rest to you.

721661901.text: Uhh, Paimon's getting nervous... It's like that time with Dusky Ming...

721661904.text: Huh. You're right. Paimon's sorry, Dusky Ming!

721661905.text: Ah, it's Big Brother Kama. I wonder how he's doing now.

721662001.text: ...I'll bury this here. This is where we met each other, after all.

721662002.text: I'll leave the Maushiro that I couldn't pass to you then over here.

721662003.text: If I wish to bid this... whatever this place is, farewell, I can't bring anything with me — that's what you told me before you left.

721662004.text: *sigh* So he's left Tsurumi Island already...

721662007.text: Well! Today's the day of the ceremony, so we shouldn't dwell on unhappy things!

721662008.text: I've made an agreement with Kapatcir that I'll go see her soon. Everyone's going to help me get ready, too, so I've gotta go.

721662009.text: Thanks for helping me out with the Perches! With your help, the ceremony is sure to go great this time!

721662011.text: Hmm... If you don't mind, could you help me look for Grandpa Mata at the ceremonial site?

721662012.text: Even though our perch problem has been solved, there are other things we need help with. The ceremony is a very important event, after all. Lots of preparations need to be done first.

721662013.text: Huh, is that so? The last time we went to make an offering at the Perch, he was gone.

721662014.text: Gone? No, this is such an important ceremony. There's no way he'd leave it half done. I mean...

721662015.text: Ah, it's nothing. In any case, please help me out!

721662020.text: Well then, let's meet again later!

721660304.text: Huh... Does that mean that the commission's complete?

721660306.text: Anyway, since we gave Ruu our word, let's head over to the ceremonial site and have a look.

721660307.text: No take-backsies with kids, remember? Paimon doesn't wanna become a lousy adult!

721660309.text: Well, compared to being a kid, Paimon sure is closer to being an adult...

721660310.text: I mean, Dusky Ming's a kid, but she's pretty old, you know?

721660311.text: Ugh, counting's hard. Let's just skip the details, shall we?

721660501.text: ...That's just weird. And the priests on the drawings up there don't look like Grandpa Mata or the others at all.

721660505.text: They're not paying us any mind at all! Paimon's gonna get mad!

721660506.text: We might as well listen in...

721660507.text: Hah, it's time for Big Brother Kito's wild guesses! Alright, what've you got this time?

721660508.text: These murals depict a time before the Sea of Fog. A long, long time ago, there was no fog over the world, so everyone could see what was up there!

721660509.text: Up there, they could see these round- and pointy-shaped things, and these mountain-like things! That's why these ancient murals look the way they do!

721660510.text: That's some imagination you've got there, Kito!

721660512.text: But not a word of this to Grandpa Mata or Granny Una! We'll be in for an earful otherwise...

721660514.text: "Round- and pointy-shaped things"... Are they talking about the moon and stars depicted here on the mural? The fog's so thick here, it's no wonder that they couldn't see 'em.

721660515.text: So the children of Tsurumi Island thought this way, huh. Paimon wonders what else they believed?

subQuests.subQuestName: Listen in on the locals' conversations

721660701.text: ...Oh, this? Well, the secret to fishing is patience.

721660703.text: No, no, it's not boring at all. I love fishing.

721660704.text: He sounds like he's talking to someone.

721660706.text: The fish don't sing, but if you sing to them, I'm sure they can hear you.

721660707.text: Not that this means they wouldn't eat you too, of course!

721660709.text: No problem. Once you're older, I'll teach you how to fish.

721660710.text: But when you grow up, you've got to teach me the secret of the Ishine Script. I mean, this is knowledge that only gets passed through the priestly families — you know, your family.

721660711.text: For example, the words on those rocks...

721662901.text: Hmm, looks like we've gotta go look for Ruu again, huh?

721662902.text: According to what they said earlier, Ruu could be at Wakukau Shoal, Oina Beach, or the Autake Plains...

721662903.text: Ugh, why are all these names so annoying to remember...

721662904.text: The location closest to us is...

721662905.text: Seems like it should be Wakukau Shoal, right?

721662906.text: Well then, guess that's where we're starting!

721662907.text: Paimon feels cheated, though. Ruu asked us to come here, and now the people here want us to look for him.

721662910.text: #Well, if you say so, {NICKNAME}, let's do it!

721662911.text: We've got the Maushiro already anyway... As long as it doesn't disappear for no reason again.

721660802.text: Huh, to think that Ishine Script had this kind of power. Perhaps it's related to the ley lines in some way... How unexpected.

721660804.text: You're right. The previous priests did have a sense of humor, huh?

721660805.text: ...Why do I like fishing? Hmm, let me think about it for a moment...

721660806.text: If I had to put my finger on it, it's because fishing makes me feel like this ocean and the rest of the world are connected. That way, this island doesn't feel so small, even though we can't escape the Sea of Fog.

721660807.text: And... Uh, how should I say this? I guess I've also fished up all kinds of interesting stuff along the way.

721660808.text: Like for example, the knowledge that you love to sing in secret.

721660809.text: Oh, is he talking to Ruu?

721660812.text: Th—That's true, yeah... We've really seen a lot of weird stuff while traveling together, huh?

721660813.text: C'mon, it's nothing to be embarrassed about. You sing pretty well! I feel luckier just listening to you, you know?

721660815.text: You wanna sing for Makiri? Sure, but I mean, why d'you need to ask me?

721660817.text: Alright then. If you're going to Oina Beach, say hi to Kama and the others for me.

721660818.text: Careful now, if you get lost in the fog, just play the Maushiro. I'll come find you for sure.

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the feather to search for clues
Solve the mystery of the stones

721661002.text: Would you like to come with me?

721661004.text: I'm serious! The world outside this fog really does exist!

721661005.text: I've seen people come in from the outside. Once, there was someone who came to the island, lost their way in the fog, and injured themselves in a fall as a result.

721661006.text: That person told me all sorts of things about the outside world. He said that he came from an island on the other side of the sea. There's no fog there — only rolling green lands, a blue sky, and a golden sun.

721661007.text: He said that the Thunderbird always flies from our island to his, and it was the sight of the Thunderbird in flight that made him want to come over and see what it's like here.

721661009.text: I know, right? I found it really mysterious, too!

721661010.text: So how about it, then? Wanna come with me? This place is just too stifling.

721661011.text: Grandpa Mata isn't a bad person, but he just isn't willing to doubt our ancestors' words. But as for me, I want to go see what the outside world is like!

721661012.text: Anyway, I hate the idea of offering people to the Thunderbird... And I'm sure the Thunderbird probably hates it too.

721661014.text: Well, about Kama... That's true, huh. If we left him alone here...

721661015.text: But I get it. If you've decided to stay, then I'm sure this place will become a better one thanks to you!

721661102.text: If I sing here, no one will discover me, right...?

721661103.text: Hmm... Maybe I should go deeper inside!

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the feather to search for clues

721660903.text: Huh, that's the weird "Kama" from before...

721660904.text: Sorry to disappoint you, but I've picked every last seashell off this beach today!

721660905.text: I mean, wasn't our intention to give them to him so—

721660908.text: Hehe, maybe I should say instead that you've come at just the right time.

721660909.text: I mean, aren't there some rocks with that... Uh, whatever you call that writing again, on them.

721660910.text: I remember you saying that the order was very important, Ruu. So if we mess the rocks' order up...

721660911.text: They call it the Ishine Script. I've said this before, I don't think this is a good idea.

721660912.text: And Ruu's here too. I don't think he'll let us do this, considering that he's the son of the priest and all...

721660915.text: Hah! See? I always knew Ruu wasn't some stick-in-the-mud!

721660917.text: Hahaha, this is real funny, watching a future priest touch these stones just like the records say they should... and then coming up blank in the end.

721660918.text: I still think this isn't right.

721660919.text: Pfft, this guy's a bore. You know what? Let's not hang out with him. Let's go ruin-delving with Kito and Kina!

721660920.text: Actually, Ruu, since you're pretty friendly with those two, could you remind them to please take care of themselves?

721660921.text: I, too, believe that there are green lands beyond the Sea of Fog, and humans too, and that there were people and history before the Thunderbird came, but someone needs to record the things that happened in our village.

721660923.text: You know what, Ruu? You should grow older faster.

721660924.text: If you were the priest, I'm sure you'd lead us all out of the Sea of Fog to see the outside world...

721660925.text: I wonder, can I wait for that day to come?

721660927.text: Ah, right. Kama said that he saw you at the Autake Plains the other day.

721660928.text: You've gotta be careful over there. The fog is thickest in that area — you fall off the cliff and that's the end for you!

721660929.text: Mm. If you really do have to go, take me with you.

721660930.text: That's right! Kama over here's got a brain like a rock, but he's no ordinary rock — he's got a sense of direction!

subQuests.subQuestName: Restore the stones and solve the puzzle

721661501.text: I need to reflect on how I speak to people...

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the feather to search for clues

721661305.text: We've met bake-danuki on the other islands before... Could this all be a big trick of theirs!?

721661307.text: Let's take stock of the situation first, shall we?

721661309.text: If we have to keep trudging through all this cloud and fog, it had better be worth it!

721661311.text: Even though we don't know if it'll disappear or not...

721661312.text: Hopefully, we can get it back to Miss Sumida this time!

721661313.text: There's a person here who looks a lot like Kama...

721661314.text: He looks like him and he's also got the name to match. Very suspicious...

721661315.text: Time passes strangely on Tsurumi Island...

721661316.text: Hmm. Now that you mention it...

721661317.text: When we spoke to Ruu, it felt really weird, like time was passing differently for him and us...

721661318.text: Oh! Right, and he met Ryuuji and Roald, didn't he?

721661319.text: The people here can't seem to see us.

721661320.text: Is that so? Hmm, Paimon did get a weird feeling as well when we tried talking to them.

721661321.text: They didn't even look at us at all! So rude!

721663601.text: #Ooh, looks like there's another Thunderbird statue here. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's give our feather a try!

721663602.text: There seem to be some missing stones over there... Let's find the matching stones and return them to their places. That should be the ticket!

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the feather to search for clues
Return the stones to their rightful place

721662803.text: Yup! We've gotta make sure that we've still got that Maushiro.

721662806.text: If not, this trip is gonna be a wash as well!

721662807.text: Phew, that's great! It didn't go missing this time.

721662808.text: Alrighty then! Back to Miss Sumida's we go!

721662805.text: We've gotta make sure that we've still got that Maushiro, of course!

subQuests.subQuestName: Solve the mystery of the stones

721661201.text: Curious tunes, tiny human. Afraid not of thunder and storms?

721661202.text: Ruu seems to be talking to someone...

721663302.text: I really hope you've brought the Maushiro this time... Or else...

721663303.text: ...Or else my novel will never get written!

721663304.text: Oh, come on! A commission of this level was a piece of cake for us!

721663305.text: #C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's show her the Maushiro we found!

721663306.text: Let's finish this commission, get paid, and head over to Kiminami Restaurant for a good meal...

721663308.text: Paimon feels like she's had this conversation before. Is it just Paimon's imagination?

721663311.text: And it's good that it is, too!

721663312.text: I... Is this it? Is this how I, Sumida, will obtain the Maushiro?

721660602.text: Ahh... So this is a Maushiro?

721660603.text: You know, I can't help but feel a bit disappointed.

721660607.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I'm just thinking that it lacks, you know, that sense of destiny.

721660608.text: This is an artifact retrieved from the wreckage of a civilization from which no laughter or song has been heard for thousands of years. To think that I would get my hands on it so easily...

721662401.text: Hmm. You know what? I have another guess.

721662402.text: Ooh, look at you, Big Brother Kito, you've got two guesses in a row!

721662404.text: (I wonder... Does Grandpa Mata also not know about what happened so long ago?)

721662406.text: (Just think about it, Kina... He said that a long, long time ago, when the darkness fell, the Great Thunderbird protected us using the Sea of Fog.)

721662407.text: (But if it was that long ago , Grandpa can't have seen that for himself, whether it be the sights up there, or the outside world itself...)

721662408.text: (I think that even the belief that the Great Thunderbird is protecting us with this fog might be fake!)

721662409.text: (That's mighty bold of you, Kito! But... you might be right!)
